name: Deltarune BGM
creator: leafus
description:
# Deltarune BGM

Replaces the default Summoners Rift soundtrack to soundtrack from Deltarune chapters 1 - 5.

## In-game Soundtracks

| In game stage | Soundtrack    |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| Game start [0 - 1:20] | [The Legend](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PibYmujLubI) |
| Early game [1:20 - Tier 2 turret down] | [Field of hopes and dreams](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9oDZ2vN9XF0), [Garden of hopes and dreams](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MzEHcwoNlbE) |
| Mid game [Tier 2 turret down - Inhibitor down] | [A CYBER'S WORLD?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EM8WM9hUFO8), [WELCOME TO THE CITY](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uiou1f5nzlU) |
| End game [Inhibitor down - The End] | [Raise up your bat](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=85WD93lz5GU), [Hammer Of Justice](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tBdLO8u-0L8) |
| Lose | [I'm Very Bad](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r34vSTUpcgs) |
| Win | [Your Power](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YeU41eDS90A) |

| In game event | Soundtrack    |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| River| [My castle town](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RKQUblO-iCs) |
| Void grubs | [Vapor Buster](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3vh8LYSuOvA) |
| Void grubs [fight] | [Ruder Buster](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_A8SQAQ_yRo) |
| Herold | [TV WORLD](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DstO9slC_5U) |
| Baron | [BIG SHOT](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V31PVkwzpEY) |
